fusions.name: Canopy Drop
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles onto the target and chop down, dealing 15 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Whirling Hatchet
fusions.desc: Hurls your axe at a target up to 8 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Felled Trunk
fusions.desc: Drops a trunk 6 tiles long across the ground for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Felling Instinct
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
